extraction.title: Add Client resource type and scopes to authorization schema
extraction.head: feature-clients-authz-implementation
extraction.summary_counts: 10 files reviewed, 6 comments; 10 files reviewed, 1 comment

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding a CLIENTS resource type with six scopes (CONFIGURE, MANAGE, MAP_ROLES, MAP_ROLES_CLIENT_SCOPE, MAP_ROLES_COMPOSITE, VIEW) to AdminPermissionsSchema, plus a new ClientPermissionsV2 class, MgmtPermissionsV2 wiring, a feature-flag check on the AdminPermissions listener, and test refactoring into AbstractPermissionTest. Confidence score 3/5. Flags that AdminPermissionsSchema.getResourceName() does not handle clients, and that ClientPermissionsV2 has an unused getEvaluationContext method and several UnsupportedOperationException methods.
style: The getEvaluationContext method (which builds a DefaultEvaluationContext with a kc.client.id attribute) is defined but never used in the current implementation.
syntax: Extra space after the assignment operator; should read as a single-spaced 'Resource resource = resourceStore.findByName(...)' statement.

syntax: The requireView() method signature returns void, but its Javadoc says it returns true when canView() is true. Suggests rewording the Javadoc to say it throws ForbiddenException when canView() is false.

syntax: The requireViewClientScopes() method signature returns void, but its Javadoc says it returns true. Suggests rewording the Javadoc to describe throwing ForbiddenException when canViewClientScopes() is false.
logic: Passing null to clients().create() may not test the intended forbidden-creation scenario; suggests using a proper ClientRepresentation object instead.
syntax: Missing space after a comma in the createUserPolicy(realm, client, ...) method call parameters. Suggested change adds the space.
Second review (after an @greptileai mention by the benchmark's author on Aug 7, 2025) summarizes the PR as introducing the Clients resource type into the FGAP v2 model. Confidence score 3/5.
logic: Flag mismatch: this listener checks ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ while other methods check the V2 flag, so if only V2 is enabled, permissions will not be cleaned up on role removal.

extraction.notes: Two Greptile reviews: the first (Jul 28, 2025) with 6 inline comments, a second re-review (Aug 7, 2025) with 1 inline comment. The scorer uses only the Jul 28 review.
